/**
 * @name SQL injection in SQLAlchemy
 * @description Untrusted user input flowing into SQL execution methods can lead to SQL injection
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/sql-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-089
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SqlInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("sqlalchemy").getMember("text").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("sqlalchemy").getMember("execute").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("sqlalchemy").getMember("executemany").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("sqlalchemy").getMember("engine").getMember("execute").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("sqlalchemy").getMember("orm").getMember("execute").getACall()
      ) and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SqlInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SqlInjectionConfig>;
import SqlInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from SqlInjectionFlow::PathNode source, SqlInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where SqlInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential SQL injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: SQL injection via user input flowing into SQL execution methods (text(), execute(), executemany())
SQL injection via user input flowing to SQLAlchemy's text() function

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

/**
 * @name Code execution via eval/exec
 * @description Detects dangerous eval() or exec() calls that could lead to arbitrary code execution

 * @id cwe-94

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // eval() calls
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    // exec() calls  
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    // compile() with exec mode
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution via eval/exec/compile that could execute arbitrary code."
